Rahul Gandhi Claims China Blocked Indian Army Patrols in Arunachal

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi claimed that China has stopped the Indian Army from patrolling certain areas along the border in Arunachal Pradesh. He stated this during a visit to the region. Separately, students in Arunachal Pradesh marched towards the border. A former BJP minister questioned Prime Minister Modi regarding the border situation. The Congress party, led by Mallikarjun Kharge, has asked Prime Minister Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah to clarify reports about China blocking patrols in Arunachal.
